The spawn answer no longer tags a hand of its own with the session's hand. Committed as `23d4245` on `main`, which is the branch you were on; I didn't create a new branch.

- **Shared constant:** `src/q/hand.go` adds `const HandOfItsOwn = "You are a hand of your own on this box"`. The pull's `spawnPrompt` in `src/pull/pull_branch.go` now builds its opening line from it.
- **Spawn answer:** `src/modules/hooks/spawn.go` skips the session tag when the prompt starts with `q.HandOfItsOwn`, as well as when the `own` field is set. I matched on the opening phrase rather than the whole line, so the tag stays off whatever follows it.
- **Test:** `TestASpawnOfAHandOfItsOwnTakesNoSessionTag` in `spawn_test.go` covers a hand-line spawn with no `own` field and with `own` set. The no-`own` case fails against the old `spawn.go` and passes with the fix.
- **Results:** `./RUNME.sh test src/modules/hooks/spawn_test.go` is green, the `hooks`, `pull` and `q` Go packages pass, and `./RUNME.sh check` exits 0.

The first `check` run failed on a fixture guard that wanted a `level0: FixtureOutsideHome` marker on the new test. The existing spawn test already carries that marker, so I added it to mine.

The commit message ends with the Co-Authored-By line from the attribution reminder. I did not open a pull request.
